title: Body Architecture Boundary

bodyOnVsBodyOff.identityThatDisappearsWithBodyOff: Long faceted hull silhouette: wedge prow, chine walls, ventral hull skin, dorsal deck breadth, FO1 C-sockets, stern collar.
bodyOnVsBodyOff.identityThatRemains: Four physical folios, four root stations, ventral keel, dorsal longeron, three bulkheads, bay walls, aft posts, fixed core, hollow can, handover hardware.

lossClassification.chineAndDecks: cosmetic mass wrapping a real carrier
lossClassification.prow: presentation language over an unassigned reservation; not earned front enclosure
lossClassification.sternCollar: failed presentation restatement of an already-exposed opening

topLevelInterpretation.name: EXPOSED-CARRIER VEHICLE
topLevelInterpretation.sentence: Quarto is four folios on a frozen keel/bay/post chassis with an inspectable open-stern handover. BODY-SHELL-03.1 is explanatory presentation around that machine, not an unfinished fuselage and not a structural body waiting to be promoted.

rejected.B: Partial physical body would invite promoting presentation interfaces that are already honest as skin, or filling regions that are intentionally exposed or unassigned.
rejected.C: Structural body required assumes a conventional fuselage obligation the frozen machine does not have. Filling the mid-body would invent an interior US1 showed does not exist.
rejected.D: Presentation already sufficient overclaims. 03.1 is not finished body architecture; SO1 is a negative presentation result.
rejected.E: Frozen geometry plus FO1/SO1 is enough to judge. Remaining unknowns are professions and later functional requirements, not the body type.

doNotPromotePresentationLanguage: BODY-SHELL-03.1 seven masses as a set
dorsal deck as a hull roof (BODY_DORSAL_DECK_*)
open stern collar (BODY_COLLAR_*) including unmerged SO1 throat geometry
any mid-body volume fill or conventional fuselage
any nacelle, cowling, boat-tail, or can-following sleeve
remainExposed: mid-body carrier: VENTRAL_KEEL, DORSAL_LONGERON, BULKHEAD_Z1p15 and interstitial faces
fixed propulsion core, hollow can, receiver, capture, locks, shoes, rails
folio root hardware: hinges, socket rails, nest pins, catches
intentionallyUnassigned: KEEP_COCKPIT (historical name only) front reserved volume

nextSlice.label: none yet; wait for functional requirements
nextSlice.why: BA1 finds no missing fuselage and no body-architecture hole that presentation or a new shell can honestly fill. A later slice may exist if a functional requirement creates a new physical relationship. BA1 does not create that requirement.
nextSlice.noteOnSr1: CURRENT_STATE still lists MT1-SR1 as the architecture-chain next slice. BA1 does not authorize, start, or replace SR1. SR1 is utilities-on-proven-skeleton, not body.

so1DoctrineOnly.rule: The frame owns the opening; it does not own the can.
so1DoctrineOnly.geometry: none. Do not turn the rule into a collar, throat, nacelle, or terminal frame in this slice.
so1DoctrineOnly.whyFo1WorkedAndSo1DidNot: FO1 explained an existing local physical relationship (root + folio) that already was the visual event in whole-machine cameras. SO1 tried to make a short presentation frame own a 2.55 m can stroke that continues past the hull cut; the visual event in DRIVE 3/4 and rear is the can, which is supposed to remain exposed.

decisionMap.physicalReality: Four physical folio (book) armor/underside stacks with frozen span, chord, thickness, and 70° haunch. Front pair lower/shorter at P.fl; rear pair higher/larger at P.rl.
decisionMap.currentPresentationClaim: In DRIVE, proud docked side panels of a chine hull. In SPREAD, outboard planform leaving empty C-sockets.
decisionMap.spreadObligation: Remain the wide envelope. Do not add hull mass to equalize density with DRIVE. Empty stations are FO1's job, not folio reskinning.
decisionMap.driveObligation: Primary side-body. Stay proud of the chine. Do not bury flush.
decisionMap.futureArchitectureImplication: None for body type. Profession remains unassigned and is not required to read folios as body faces.
decisionMap.doNotTouch: Do not rename BOOK/book identities. Do not assign wing/shield/radiator/tank. Do not change 70° haunch, spans, or authority solids.

decisionMap.physicalReality: Four registered keel-meeting stations: hinges, socket rails, nest receivers, pins, catches. BODY OFF shows roots with no presentation sockets.
decisionMap.currentPresentationClaim: Short FO1 webs present the frozen hinge; they do not replace it.
decisionMap.spreadObligation: Roots stay visible as the physical origin of the empty bay.
decisionMap.driveObligation: Roots stay visible under/behind the proud folio. Hardware is not jewelry to hide.
decisionMap.futureArchitectureImplication: Physical station already exists. A future seal/load lip would be a new requirement, not a promotion of FO1 mesh.
decisionMap.doNotTouch: Do not change frozen root geometry, nest/socket families, or registration IDs to make presentation prettier.

decisionMap.physicalReality: No physical C-socket. Reach 0.16 m front / 0.22 m rear is presentation only. Dock-face X front ±0.84 m, rear ±0.90 m.
decisionMap.currentPresentationClaim: Chine becomes a repeated lip–recess–sill–web receiving shoulder. SPREAD empty bay still reads as the flank that left. ACCEPTED.
decisionMap.spreadObligation: Empty shoulders must read as owned receiving locations, not maintenance cutouts.
decisionMap.driveObligation: Folio seats proud as flank in that shoulder. Front lower/shorter; rear higher/larger.
decisionMap.futureArchitectureImplication: Do not promote the C-socket into structure. Presentation already solved station ownership.
decisionMap.doNotTouch: No eighth mass, no reach increase, no flush dock, no chine-wall window, no station humps.

decisionMap.physicalReality: None. Chine is BODY-SHELL-03.1 faceted presentation shoulder at |x|=P.keel.halfWidth. Not the ventral keel.
decisionMap.currentPresentationClaim: Long rising faceted hull side; quiet spine through stations after FO1 value split (hull vs accent frame).
decisionMap.spreadObligation: May explain the long carrier; must not impersonate a fuselage that owns the deployed folios.
decisionMap.driveObligation: May quiet the gap between packed folios; must not claim to be the side-body (folios are).
decisionMap.futureArchitectureImplication: Do not freeze chine as structure, keepout, or volume. Removing BODY ON must leave a complete machine.
decisionMap.doNotTouch: Do not thicken the chine into a fuselage. Do not confuse chine with VENTRAL_KEEL.

decisionMap.physicalReality: VENTRAL_KEEL occupied structure, z∈[-4.95, 4.55], AABB minY 0.030 m. US1 carrier; KS1 ventral-face route candidate.
decisionMap.currentPresentationClaim: Ventral hull / belly skins the bar into a faceted hull bottom.
decisionMap.spreadObligation: Chassis remains the centerline of the wide machine. No extra belly volume required.
decisionMap.driveObligation: Same member. Presentation belly is optional explanation, not a new ground-contact claim (GE1 closed).
decisionMap.futureArchitectureImplication: Keel is already the chassis. Routes may ride faces (SR1 is a separate later question). No fuselage needed to 'complete' it.
decisionMap.doNotTouch: Do not hollow the keel. Do not delete GE1 minY structure. Do not treat presentation belly as authority.

decisionMap.physicalReality: DORSAL_LONGERON occupied structure, ~0.24×0.15 m, keel nose to bay mouth. KEEP_DORSAL sits above. Truncated; not a full-length roof.
decisionMap.currentPresentationClaim: Continuous dorsal deck from prow to stern split, with a centerline service slot over propulsion.
decisionMap.spreadObligation: Physical longeron is enough dorsal identity. Deck breadth is presentation.
decisionMap.driveObligation: Same. Deck must not consume KEEP_DORSAL.
decisionMap.futureArchitectureImplication: Do not promote deck skin into a structural roof or an interior ceiling. Longeron is the real dorsal member.
decisionMap.doNotTouch: Do not occupy KEEP_DORSAL. Do not extend a structural deck over the can corridor.

decisionMap.physicalReality: Long carrier between P.fl (z=3.22) and bay mouth (z=-1.70): keel + longeron + BULKHEAD_Z1.15 + interstitial faces. US1: occupying as a room is UNKNOWN; no empty spine.
decisionMap.currentPresentationClaim: Continuous chine hull / ventral / deck spanning the gap, reading as a conventional long body.
decisionMap.spreadObligation: Sparse beam-with-stations is legitimate SPREAD identity. Do not equalize with DRIVE by adding hull.
decisionMap.driveObligation: Packed folios are the side-body; the centerline may remain a visible carrier. 03.1 hull here is disguise, not completion.
decisionMap.futureArchitectureImplication: Adding mass would invent an interior. Missing-fuselage is the wrong diagnosis. No promotion.
decisionMap.doNotTouch: Do not fill the middle because it looks sparse. No eighth mass. No bulkhead cuts (KS1).

decisionMap.physicalReality: KEEP_COCKPIT protected box cz=3.55, hx=0.68, hy=0.95, hz=1.05. Unclaimed. Protects BULKHEAD_Z3.35. Keel nose at z=4.55. No front enclosure solids.
decisionMap.currentPresentationClaim: Wedge prow occupying the reserved front volume; not a canopy or intake.
decisionMap.spreadObligation: Do not read the wedge as a completed nose. Reservation stays protected and empty of profession.
decisionMap.driveObligation: Same. Prow is a presentation terminator of the chine, not earned front architecture.
decisionMap.futureArchitectureImplication: A front enclosure would be a new functional requirement plus occupancy study. Not BA1, not cockpit-by-default.
decisionMap.doNotTouch: Do not assign cockpit/crew/payload/sensors. Do not shrink KEEP_COCKPIT. Do not promote BODY_PROW_*.

decisionMap.physicalReality: BAY_WALL_PORT/STBD, AFT_POST_*, BULKHEAD_Z-1.70, fixed core supports. z=-1.70…-4.80. Load path to ventral keel (DP1/S5).
decisionMap.currentPresentationClaim: Aft chine and split dorsal deck open into the bay; collar frames the mouth further aft.
decisionMap.spreadObligation: Bay remains the real aft body volume (can stowed). Presentation must not close it.
decisionMap.driveObligation: Bay remains visible around the translating can. Rear folio station sits just forward (P.rl.z=-1.88).
decisionMap.futureArchitectureImplication: Bay is already physical architecture. Do not convert it into a closed engine room.
decisionMap.doNotTouch: Do not hide bay walls or posts. Do not occupy the can corridor. Do not start S6.

decisionMap.physicalReality: MUST_REMAIN_CLEAR open throat. Aft posts at z=-4.80. No physical terminal hull frame. US1: access only.
decisionMap.currentPresentationClaim: Open stern collar (150 mm hoop at COLLAR_Z≈-5.98) frames the seated-can mouth. SO1: no presentation solution in stock DRIVE 3/4 / rear.
decisionMap.spreadObligation: Same open stern. Not a DRIVE-only cap.
decisionMap.driveObligation: Can may sit in/through the opening. Frame-owns-opening-not-can is doctrine only, not new geometry.
decisionMap.futureArchitectureImplication: Strong hull-ownership of the stern is not a current requirement. A future physical terminal frame would need a new requirement, not another collar study.
decisionMap.doNotTouch: Do not retry SO1. Do not promote SO1 throat. No nacelle, boat-tail, sleeve, closed stern, or camera cheat.

decisionMap.physicalReality: Hollow positive-thickness thrust can, 1.00×0.82×2.55 m, stroke 2.55 m, stowed z=-3.25, seated center z=-5.80 occupying ≈-7.08…-4.53. Not a complete engine.
decisionMap.currentPresentationClaim: Visible through the open collar; PROP SECTION ghosts can and aft shell.
decisionMap.spreadObligation: Stowed can remains inspectable in the bay/throat.
decisionMap.driveObligation: Seated can is allowed to dominate the rear picture. That is handover identity, not a body defect.
decisionMap.futureArchitectureImplication: Do not own the can with body. Do not follow the stroke with hull.
decisionMap.doNotTouch: Do not change can stroke, color-as-engine, internals, intake, nozzle, or performance claims.

configurationAudit.sparseRead: acceptable identity of an exposed-carrier vehicle with four deployed folios
configurationAudit.not: unfinished fuselage, or unjudgeable until folio profession is known

configurationAudit.note: FO1 makes packed folios readable as proud side-body. Remaining open stern and visible carrier are identity, not incomplete DRIVE. SO1 negative does not reopen DRIVE as unfinished.
